name: How do you make an existing bathroom wheelchair accessible?

mainEntity.name: How do you make an existing bathroom wheelchair accessible?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a bathroom fully wheelchair accessible, prioritize eliminating floor transitions and ensuring adequate turning clearance. Removing a raised tub in favor of a curbless, barrier-free tile shower allows roll-in entry without tripping hazards. Doorways generally need to be widened through custom framing adjustments, followed by drywall and trim repair. Additionally, vanities should offer roll-under knee clearance, and walls must have solid wood backing installed inside the wall studs to anchor heavy-duty grab bars securely. Our crew handles the finish carpentry, framing, and tile to ensure durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Convert tubs to zero-threshold tile showers, widen doorways with custom framing, lower sink clearances, and install internal wood blocking for grab bars.
